needsVsWantsQuiz.title: Prescribed Course Textbook
needsVsWantsQuiz.description: Required reference book for your core semester programming subject.
needsVsWantsQuiz.explanation: Essential for academic success and completing graded assignments. This is a core Need.

needsVsWantsQuiz.title: Designer Branded Sneakers
needsVsWantsQuiz.description: Limited-edition shoes when you already own two pairs of comfortable sneakers.
needsVsWantsQuiz.explanation: You already have functional footwear. This purchase is driven by lifestyle and prestige, making it a Want.

needsVsWantsQuiz.title: Monthly Public Bus Pass
needsVsWantsQuiz.description: Daily transit card to commute from home to campus.
needsVsWantsQuiz.explanation: Essential transportation required to attend classes consistently. This is a Need.

needsVsWantsQuiz.title: Premium Multi-Platform Video Streaming
needsVsWantsQuiz.explanation: Entertainment is great for relaxation, but premium 4K streaming is optional and falls under Wants.

needsVsWantsQuiz.title: Emergency Medicine / Prescription
needsVsWantsQuiz.explanation: Health and physical well-being always take top priority as a non-negotiable Need.

needsVsWantsQuiz.title: Daily Gourmet Cafe Latte
needsVsWantsQuiz.description: Buying an imported vanilla latte before every morning lecture.
needsVsWantsQuiz.explanation: Caffeine can be prepared affordably at home/hostel. Cafe lattes are discretionary luxury Wants.

knowledgeCheck.question: According to the 50-30-20 rule, what percentage of your income should go directly into savings or debt repayment?
knowledgeCheck.rationale: 20% is the standard recommended target for building emergency reserves and achieving future goals.

knowledgeCheck.question: Which of the following is considered a 'Fixed Expense' for a college student?
knowledgeCheck.rationale: Hostel rent stays constant every month and is legally required, qualifying as a fixed expense.

knowledgeCheck.question: What is the recommended student '24-Hour Rule' intended to prevent?
knowledgeCheck.rationale: The 24-Hour Rule gives your brain emotional cooling time before buying non-essential items.
